summary.intent: Complete Phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) by executing gap closure plans, collecting definitive three-point local baselines, and getting PR #342 merged after code review.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 fully executed with all 4 plans complete, definitive three-point local baselines collected (concurrent SDK + pebbleds together yield p95 -13%, p99 -15%, throughput +7% at 50 clients; pebbleds alone eliminates the 75-client failure mode), PR #342 created and all 10 review threads resolved.

repo: The two optimizations (concurrent SDK pins + pebbleds datastore) are synergistic — concurrent pins alone cause a regression at 50 clients (p95 jumps from 18.7s to 44.7s, throughput -26%) because they double Kubo's concurrent write load, which flatfs cannot handle
Pebbleds eliminates the 75-client failure mode entirely: zero errors vs 10, throughput +44%, p95 -53% compared to sequential SDK + flatfs at same concurrency
Load test secrets (LOAD_TEST_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) must be passed as inline shell env vars — vitest does not load dotenv, so .env files are not read
The THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is sent as X-Throttle-Bypass header; BypassableThrottlerGuard does timing-safe comparison and skips rate limiting only in non-production environments
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL was pointing to localhost mock-ipns-routing (port 3001); someguy on 192.168.133.114:8190 is the correct delegated routing endpoint for staging-representative testing
Active CIDs are tracked in two DB tables: pinned_cids (file content) and folder_ipns (latest_cid IS NOT NULL) — anything pinned on Kubo not in these tables is stale from failed e2e runs
PERF-09 was missing from REQUIREMENTS.md entirely (requirements stopped at PERF-08) despite both plans referencing it
JWT tokens expire under long-running load tests — at 75 clients with flatfs, 401 errors appear alongside 500s and 'Key wrapping failed'

code.finding: batchPublishIpnsRecords returns { totalSucceeded, totalFailed }; the totalFailed check needs a null guard since existing test mocks return undefined — use optional chaining or check fulfilled result existence
Added ipns:batchPublishFailed typed event to match the share:reWrapFailed pattern for SDK error observability
Extracted createTestConfig and setupFolder shared helpers from three duplicate test files (client.test.ts, client-extended.test.ts, client-upload-concurrency.test.ts)
batchPublishIpnsRecords mock must return { totalSucceeded, totalFailed } shape — previously returned undefined causing silent totalFailed check bypass

workflow: GSD gap closure flow: execute-phase → verifier finds gaps → plan-phase --gaps creates gap plans → execute-phase --gaps-only executes only gap_closure:true plans → re-verify
For concurrency probing, push until errors appear then use the last clean run as the baseline client count — in this case 50 clients was the ceiling (75 produced 401s/500s/timeouts with flatfs)

The parallel cutover strategy for Kubo datastore migration: spin up temp pebbleds container alongside old flatfs, cross-check Kubo pins against DB, pin valid CIDs to new node, let deploy create blank volume, then cp -a from new volume to deploy volume and rm temp
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot review threads can come in waves — running /resolve-pr-reviews may need to be run multiple times as new automated reviews are posted
Background task notifications for killed processes (duplicate API instances) are expected noise after process cleanup — can be ignored if PID matches previously killed processes

friction: Multiple duplicate API processes accumulated (PIDs 53301, 61103, 70577) from repeated API starts across the session — not killed automatically
Background 100-client and 75-client probe runs timed out at 600s, requiring TaskOutput polling to recover partial results
SDK checkout for pre-optimization baseline (git checkout <hash> -- packages/sdk/src/client.ts) failed because working directory was inside tests/load — had to run from repo root
Run 2 result (concurrent SDK + flatfs) was worse than baseline, which was unexpected and required explanation — the doubling of concurrent Kubo writes was the root cause
Web frontend was killed by the process cleanup that was targeting duplicate API instances
Some GraphQL review thread queries returned 0 unresolved threads despite the PR UI showing open comments — had to fall back to REST API to fetch specific review details
API dotenv not loaded by vitest caused load test secrets to silently be empty when set in .env files — discovered late in the session
